tuning.rule: history_bc only: 16 configurations, depth 3, 30,000 updates each on training seed 10; select the highest mean coverage on the tuning bank, then success, then the smaller head. Fixed before any final-seed training.

config.hypothesis: Two-sided. The planner matched one-frame BC in coverage; whether it matches competent imitation baselines on identical data and starts is open.
config.status: Registered 2026-10-26 before any history-BC configuration was trained. Replaces the withdrawn s3-baselines, split for compute reasons before any result existed. Frozen v2 models are re-evaluated on this study's new banks.
